repairs.name: Hob_Atlas
repairs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair this exact 4-column, 1-row game sprite animation sheet. Preserve all four distinct poses and the exact character identity, palette, paper/porcelain material and hand-ink illustration. SHRINK EACH INDIVIDUAL CHARACTER to 70% of its current size inside ITS OWN equally-sized column. Centre it inside that column, align feet to the same baseline at 82% of canvas height. Restore any cut-off cup, hand, wing tip or spout. Each entire figure must have generous transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES of its own cell, at least 12% each side, including at both outside edges of the entire sheet. Four isolated figures total, evenly spaced, not touching. Transparent RGBA backdrop, keep original wide canvas aspect, no floor/shadows/text/grid. Do not shrink the sheet as a whole: shrink each figure separately so it cannot cross a cell boundary.
repairs.reason: The outermost cup/wing edge touches its image border; shrink individual poses into their cells using painted.
